name: z-ai-spend-auditor-agent
description: Tenant-side Node agent for the z-ai-spend-auditor TEE contract on Terminal 3 Network (T3N).

remarks.TMPDIR: All scripts go through scripts/safe-tsx.mjs, which re-execs tsx with TMPDIR=/tmp when $TMPDIR/tsx-<uid>/<pid>.pipe would exceed the macOS 104-char socket limit (Paperclip run scratch dirs trigger this).
